{
  "project_id": "P-UK-HyNetCCUSCluster",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "The UK ETS carbon price is currently too low to incentivize CCUS deployment without subsidy, making emitting carbon cheaper than capturing and storing it.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide long-term business model subsidy contracts (such as 15-year CfD-style strike price agreements) to bridge the financial gap between carbon market prices and capture costs.",
      "evidence": "The Carbon Price is currently too low to incentivise deployment, there is a first-mover disadvantage due to high start-up costs"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "CO2 could leak from deep geological storage reservoirs or transportation pipelines, causing environmental damage and financial liabilities.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Underwrite low-probability, high-impact leakage risks via the Supplementary Compensation Agreement (SCA) and maintain extensive offshore sentinel and monitoring wells.",
      "evidence": "government will underwrite several key high-impact, low-probability risks – principally relating to CO2 leakage – via the Supplementary Compensation Agreement (SCA)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Sequential FID timeline across anchor and build-out projects risks T&S network underutilisation if build-out capture projects are delayed or fail to reach FID.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Include uncertain cost reopeners in the economic licence to disallow T&S CapEx for uncommitted projects, while filling excess capacity through the HyNet top-up process.",
      "evidence": "This incremental approach... introduces a risk of network underutilisation and revenue support exposure"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Complex cross-chain technical interdependencies between T&S network operations and capture projects could lead to cascading operational outages or stranded volume risks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish the DESNZ Cluster Sponsor Function to actively manage cross-chain delivery risks and coordinate outage schedules with Ofgem and LCCC.",
      "evidence": "In addition, HMG covers some of the ‘cross-chain’ risks from the interdependencies between the T&SCo and capture projects."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Construction capital expenditure overruns on the T&S network could increase overall infrastructure costs and funding requirements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce a 40/60 cost sharing factor within the RAB economic licence model, ensuring the T&SCo only recoups 40% of CapEx incurred above agreed allowances.",
      "evidence": "Eni T&S network construction overruns... the T&SCo will only recoup 40% of any costs in excess of the agreed level."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Decommissioning costs for offshore platforms, wells, and pipelines at end-of-life could exceed accumulated funds, creating a financial deficit.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce mandatory financial security requirements through NSTA and OPRED regulations and execute formal Decommissioning Shortfall Agreements.",
      "evidence": "Decommissioning fund shortfall... NSTA and Opred requirements for financial security"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Exchequer exposure reaching pre-defined financial caps could trigger Secretary of State rights to discontinue T&S network support, stranding assets.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement rigorous monthly budget control and monitoring across DESNZ, LCCC, and Ofgem to track cumulative subsidy drawdown against thresholds.",
      "evidence": "Discontinuation Agreement... if support provided reaches a defined threshold, DESNZ SoS has the right to discontinue the T&S network."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Delays in passing FID-critical secondary legislation or finalizing the CCS Network Code before contract execution could delay project financial close.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritise FID-critical secondary legislation through dedicated parliamentary schedules and conduct pre-referral engagement on the full-form CCS Network Code.",
      "evidence": "A number of activities are still ongoing to achieve FID including stage 3 negotiations... FID critical secondary legislation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Global supply chain constraints and inflation could cause capital cost increases and force re-negotiation of time-limited supplier bids if FID is delayed.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Progress anchor projects to FID expeditiously to secure time-limited supplier bids and perform continuous cost and procurement assurance.",
      "evidence": "Reopening the supplier bids would be a dynamic scenario... underlying costs are expected to increase."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Hard-to-abate UK industrial emitters could suffer carbon leakage by relocating manufacturing abroad if decarbonisation costs remain uncompetitive.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Provide predictable 15-year business model revenue support and upfront capital co-funding through the CIF and NZHF to preserve UK industrial competitiveness.",
      "evidence": "manufacturers of critical industrial materials may relocate to more favourable jurisdictions due to the escalating costs of emissions; otherwise known as ‘carbon leakage’."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Key delivery and regulatory partner organisations (such as Ofgem, LCCC, and CGL) may lack sufficient resourcing or capability post-FID to oversee complex contracts.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Require partner organisations to complete formal Organisational Readiness Statements and deploy specialized technical, legal, and PMO advisory support.",
      "evidence": "Partner organisations’ capacity and capability... partner organisations with significant responsibility to complete Organisational Readiness Statements."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Local public or community opposition regarding CO2 infrastructure, compression, and pipeline routing could cause planning delays and public resistance.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Proactively engage local communities, share best practices through the CCUS Council, and partner with Arm's Length Bodies to demonstrate safety.",
      "evidence": "Testing has shown awareness of CCUS is growing but with many still undecided of their view."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Withdrawal or insolvency of individual anchor or build-out emitters (e.g. EETH or Protos) could breach volume assumptions and increase unit costs for remaining network users.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct rigorous corporate financial due diligence prior to FID and execute the HyNet top-up process to recruit replacement CO2 volume producers.",
      "evidence": "Discontinuation risk for EETH and Protos... BLN0 has requested to withdraw from the CCUS sequencing process"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Proposed subsidy structures or capital grant distributions could face legal challenge or adverse assessment under the UK Subsidy Control Act 2022.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Submit formal subsidy assessments to the Subsidy Advice Unit (SAU) at least 3 months prior to FID and conduct thorough pre-referral alignment with DBT.",
      "evidence": "Subsidy controls and other legal requirements... assessment of each subsidy scheme will be submitted by DESNZ to the Subsidy Advice Unit"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Operational fraud or misrepresentation in grant funding claims (CIF/NZHF) or ongoing revenue support payments could result in exchequer financial loss.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy the DESNZ Central Grants and Loans (CGL) team and LCCC to enforce strict claim verification, audit rights, and compliance checks under Grant Funding Agreements.",
      "evidence": "Fraud... Central Grants and Loans (CGL) Team will be the delivery partner for all grants awarded."
    }
  ]
}
